01

About

I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Electronics & Instrumentation Technology at the University of Kashmir. My work brings together antenna engineering, electromagnetics, and RF and microwave systems.

I received my Ph.D. from IIT Delhi and my M.Tech. from IIITDM Jabalpur. My research interests include millimeter-wave and MIMO antennas, metamaterials, metasurfaces, and RF circuits, with applications in wireless communication and microwave imaging.

02

Research

ANTENNA SYSTEMS

Antennas & wireless communication

High-gain, MIMO, multibeam, and beam-steerable antennas for microwave and millimeter-wave communication.

ENGINEERED MATERIALS

Metamaterials & metasurfaces

Electromagnetic wave control using anisotropic media, planar metasurfaces, and lens-based antenna systems.

SENSING & IMAGING

Microwave imaging

Microwave imaging systems and metasurface antennas for sensing applications.

RF ENGINEERING

RF & microwave circuits

Passive and active circuits, reconfigurable microwave components, filtennas, and RF energy harvesting.

RESEARCH SUPPORT · 2025

Prime Minister’s Early Career Research Grant

Principal Investigator · Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)

Research on the design of microwave imaging systems.
